question: Around how large are the shields Garf holds in both hands? Also, has he thought of sharpening the tips of the shields to increase their combat effectiveness?
answer: I see them as being one step larger than Inuibanjin's invincible bracers. (note: character from the Rurouni Kenshin series?) If you try to move around something too large it interferes with the movement, so sort of just enough to cover around the arms. If you sharpen the tips of the shields, the killing power goes up, so he's not likely to do that.
